description: Optional settings for the standard NonLinLoc adapter.

fields.date: Pick-table reference date in YYYYMMDDHHMM format
fields.native_obs: Boolean; use event.obs rather than picks_simple.txt
fields.prepare_only: Boolean; prepare controls and grids without running NLLoc

notes: The velocity model, stations and observations are supplied as input files.
The standard adapter uses the bundled 1-D workflow geometry; advanced control generation belongs to Nonlinlocpy.
Native binaries are selected with --bin-dir or the bundled runtime/bin directory.
